## Executive summary

This report demonstrates an end-to-end descriptive analysis using fictional encounter records. It is a programming and reporting exercise, not a clinical quality assessment.

## Data and cohort

The analysis unit is one encounter. Include admission dates from 1 January 2026 inclusive to 1 April 2026 exclusive. The department lookup must contain one row per department identifier. Blank systolic blood pressure (SBP) values remain missing and are excluded only from SBP-specific summaries.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

academy_root = Path.cwd()
data_dir = academy_root / "datasets" / "v03_python"
enc = pd.read_csv(data_dir / "encounters.csv",
                  dtype={"encounter_id":"string","patient_id":"string","department_id":"string"})
dept = pd.read_csv(data_dir / "departments.csv", dtype={"department_id":"string"})
enc["admission_date"] = pd.to_datetime(enc["admission_date"], errors="coerce")
enc["systolic_bp"] = pd.to_numeric(enc["systolic_bp"], errors="coerce")
assert enc["encounter_id"].is_unique
cohort = enc.loc[
    (enc.admission_date >= "2026-01-01") &
    (enc.admission_date < "2026-04-01")
].copy()
joined = cohort.merge(dept[["department_id","department_name"]],
                      on="department_id", how="left",
                      validate="many_to_one", indicator=True)
assert len(joined) == len(cohort)
```

## Data-quality summary

```{python}
quality = pd.DataFrame({
    "Check": ["Encounter rows", "Unique encounter IDs", "Distinct patients",
              "Missing SBP", "Unmatched department keys"],
    "Result": [len(cohort), cohort.encounter_id.nunique(),
               cohort.patient_id.nunique(), cohort.systolic_bp.isna().sum(),
               (joined["_merge"] != "both").sum()]
})
quality
```

## Department summary

```{python}
summary = (joined.groupby("department_name", dropna=False)
    .agg(encounter_n=("encounter_id","size"),
         unique_patients=("patient_id","nunique"),
         sbp_nonmissing_n=("systolic_bp","count"),
         mean_sbp=("systolic_bp","mean"),
         median_sbp=("systolic_bp","median"))
    .reset_index())
summary["sbp_missing_n"] = summary.encounter_n - summary.sbp_nonmissing_n
summary["sbp_completeness_pct"] = 100 * summary.sbp_nonmissing_n / summary.encounter_n
summary.round(2)
```

## Visualization

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
joined.systolic_bp.dropna().plot.hist(ax=ax, bins=12, edgecolor="black")
ax.set(title="Recorded systolic blood pressure distribution",
       xlabel="Systolic blood pressure (mmHg)", ylabel="Encounter count")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Interpretation and limitations

- The records are synthetic and are not representative clinical evidence.
- Encounter-level records may repeat a patient; inferential methods must account for within-patient correlation where relevant.
- Missing SBP is not imputed. Department means use nonmissing observations only.
- Department differences are descriptive and must not be interpreted as rankings, treatment effects or causal relationships.
- The dataset is small and was created for learning; no clinical or operational conclusions about a real hospital are justified.

## Reproducibility

Record the Python version, package versions, execution date, input filenames, cohort dates and code revision. Run the project tests before rendering. The separate R scripts independently reproduce the summary and optional figures; compare their output tables with the Python and SQL outputs.
